title: Unify record validation contract and remove dead code
description: CsvValidator.validateRecord validates ALTERNATIVE headers (Дата/Вес (кг)) while production rows carry PRIMARY headers (Время измерения/Вес(кг)); real Goodvibes rows always report missing fields and inject ignored defaults. Rewire validateRecord to the primary contract (keep alternative support), wire CsvFieldMapper.normalizeWeight/Bmi/Fat into RecordProcessor so comma decimals are normalized (currently a 79,65 weight fails GarminCsvSchema and kills the whole generation), remove dead kg-to-lbs branch in mapToGarminFormat and unused createFieldMapping, fix GarminCsvSchemaTest comma-decimal test to assert normalized output. CLAUDE.md mandate: parsing/normalization changes MUST come with unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: validateRecord accepts primary Goodvibes headers and validates date/weight/bmi/fat values; comma-decimal input 79,65 produces 79.65 in output CSV; kg-to-lbs dead branch removed; all unit tests pass including new regression tests; RecordProcessorTest expectations updated for primary contract
close_reason: Dual-contract validateRecord + comma-decimal normalization + dead code removal committed c2c0385; 7 new primary-contract tests + regressions; suite 107/107 green

Goal: ./gradlew assembleDebug + testDebugUnitTest + lintDebug green (source-level compile errors from concurrent agents are out of scope).
